maintenance_led.reason: Sells leadership training content, All Access Pass subscriptions, coaching and consulting; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private corporations paying for leadership training and subscriptions; government agencies and schools are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its All Access Pass subscriptions, training content and Leader in Me programs; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Leadership training and content subscriptions are discretionary; clients can change training vendors without regulatory or operational downtime.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: subscription embedding in culture adds some switching friction, but it is not operationally critical.
